# Code of Conduct Enforcement Guide (`.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_ENFORCEMENT.md`)

Operational procedures, confidentiality duties, and graduated escalation ladders used by maintainers to enforce [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

---

## 1. Enforcement Authority & Contact Channel

- **Primary Escalation Point**: **`creatergame31@gmail.com`**
- **Scope**: Applies to GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, public repositories, community channels, and multiplayer clan/chat surfaces in **Voxel Realms RPG**.

---

## 2. Incident Triage & Response SLA

1. **Acknowledgment**: Report receipt acknowledged confidentially within **24 hours**.
2. **Fact-Finding**: Gather immutable logs (`securityAuditLog`, linked PR/issue comments, support tickets) without exposing reporter identities.
3. **Recusal**: Any maintainer involved in or closely affiliated with a reported party must recuse themselves from decision voting.

---

## 3. Graduated Enforcement Ladder (Aligned with Contributor Covenant v2.1)

| Level                | Trigger Examples                                       | Action                                                                    | Duration / Appeal                            |
| :------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------- |
| **1. Correction**    | Uncivil remarks, off-topic hostility                   | Private written warning clarifying violation                              | Permanent record; warning expires in 90 days |
| **2. Warning**       | Repeated disrespect or baiting after Correction        | Formal recorded warning + temporary cooldown                              | 7–14 days cooling-off period                 |
| **3. Temporary Ban** | Sustained harassment, packet griefing, doxxing threats | Suspension from repo interactions & game servers                          | 30–90 days; reinstatement review             |
| **4. Permanent Ban** | Severe harassment, CSAM, malware, deliberate sabotage  | Permanent block across GitHub org & Root RBAC (`creatergame31@gmail.com`) | Appeal only to Root Admin after 6 months     |
